title: Remove carpet from under the faux grass
details: Lift the faux grass, remove the carpet underneath and dispose of it, then put the faux grass back in place.

title: New screen and mount for the office French doors
details: Get a new screen and mount for the French doors in Owen's office.

title: Cover the wires by the internal door
details: Add a blank to cover the wires by the internal door.

title: Stairs: strip carpet, refinish and add cable railing
details: Remove the carpet from the stairs and refinish the wood. Add the side-mount cable railing, black wood siding on the side of the staircase and a wooden façade on the inside rail (see the reference photo). Remove the 2 blocks of wood from the wall.

title: Trim on the kitchen pony wall
details: Add a finishing piece of wood trim to the left-hand pony wall to the kitchen (left as you face downstairs). It's currently missing entirely.

title: Replace the mirrored closet doors in bedroom 3
details: Bedroom 3, next to the kitchen. Replacement doors should be white and modern, and the sliding mechanism must be robust. Suggested door below — check the size first.

title: Front door sweep and frame finish piece
details: Add a door sweep to the front door and find a finish piece for the frame.

title: Downstairs closet room: finish the surround and add a closet
details: Go with your original design — the industrial-style doors are no longer happening. Finish the exposed wood on the top of the surround, and add an additional floor-to-ceiling closet as per the reference photos (136" total: 36" double-hang section, 5' shelving section with shelves 14" apart, 52.5" single-hang section at 60"; 1.5" plywood partitions painted black, chrome bars).

title: Swap the Lutron switches for standard switches
details: Replace all the Lutron switches with standard switches (the switches on the kitchen counter).

title: Change the deadbolt to a black one
Fit the new front door
details: The new front door is already in the garage.

title: Remove the piece over the front entrance
details: Rather than fixing the piece that hangs over the front entrance, remove it entirely.

title: Replace the termite-damaged wood at the front entrance
Garage storage (black MR-MDF open grids)
details:
Custom black storage built in place from ¾" moisture-resistant MDF (MR-MDF such as Medite MR / Medex — standard MDF swells in a garage), no doors or drawers. See the plan pages in the photos.

Back wall (G2): one row of 12 open cubbies, 15" × 16" each (180" × 17" × 14" deep), ledger-hung at 67–84" AFF above both car noses, LED strip underneath. EV charger and 240V outlet stay below it.

Side wall (G1): one open grid ≈214" × 80" × 16" deep on a 4" PVC/treated plinth, top line at 84" (2" under the door track): an 18" tall bay at the back corner (shelf at 68", hooks, internal outlet), 8 columns × 5 rows of 15" × 16" cubbies (one notched under the torsion-tube bracket, ½" lips on the bottom two rows for paint), and a 76" bike bay with a network-box cutout. Leave the front 24–26" clear.

Finish: prime all cut edges (shellac or oil primer), then two coats of satin black waterborne urethane-alkyd enamel. ½" MR-MDF back panels. Tapcons or sleeve anchors at 16" centres.

Clearances: nothing fastens to the door tracks, torsion tube, springs or opener; keep 8" around the tube end bracket; stay 2" below ceiling pipes; keep the EV charger, outlets and network box accessible. Add a parking stop for each car.

All dimensions are estimates from photos — confirm the field measurements before cutting: wall lengths at floor and 84", ceiling and pipe heights, door-track underside, torsion tube position, opener, car nose heights, positions of the window/charger/outlets/network box, and wall construction. Tape the layout on the wall and open the garage door fully before cutting.
